note: Missouri State Parks campground on a wooded peninsula of Long Branch Lake just west of Macon. Walk-in sites are tent-only; family sites have two pads. Off-season (November-March) water is at a frost-free spigot near site 12; firewood vending by the dump station. Site 79 is prone to flooding in heavy rain. --Claude
